allocation_semantics: Preflight RIFF uint32 sizes, platform length and configured data/artifact byte limits before allocating exactly one complete artifact buffer. Caller-owned PCM is excluded. The immutable input writes directly into the artifact payload without a second frame-sized copy. Bytes returns a caller-owned full copy; WriteTo uses a fixed-size defensive scratch buffer so writers never receive artifact-owned memory. Both occur after encoding and are outside the Encode working budget.
cancellation_semantics: Validate context and all PCM metadata/hash fields before allocation; check cancellation while copying PCM, while hashing the complete artifact and immediately before publication. Failure returns no Result or partial Artifact.
container_semantics: Emit exactly one little-endian RIFF envelope with form WAVE, one 16-byte fmt chunk and one terminal data chunk. The artifact is exactly 44+data_bytes with no pad, JUNK, LIST, fact, bext, cue, metadata, unknown chunk or trailing byte. RIFF and data sizes are exact uint32 values.
excluded_responsibilities: AudioGraph evaluation, resampling, retime, gain/mix/limiting, PCM quantization/dither, channel remapping, non-stereo or non-16-bit WAVE, RF64/Wave64, codec encoding, metadata, filesystem publication and signing are outside this profile.
failure_semantics: Any context, profile, placement, geometry, hash, size, allocation or writer mismatch returns a zero Result. Encoding never repairs metadata, truncates PCM or publishes a partial artifact.
format_semantics: fmt declares WAVE_FORMAT_PCM code 1, two channels, the bound positive integer sample rate no greater than the shared strict-decoder hard maximum, byte_rate=sample_rate*4, block_align=4 and bits_per_sample=16. data is the input frame-major interleaved [FL,FR] signed two's-complement PCM16LE byte stream unchanged.
hash_semantics: ArtifactHash is SHA-256 over every encoded WAV byte including its exact header and PCM payload. SourcePCMHash is independently recomputed from the immutable input block before encoding; neither hash alone binds composition placement.
placement_semantics: WAV carries no composition origin. Result separately preserves first_composition_sample, frame_count and sample_rate; an enclosing evidence manifest must bind them to the render request.
round_trip_semantics: The byte layout is in the decoder profile's structural subset. Round-trip Decode also requires the artifact and decoded PCM to fit wavdecode's independently configured encoded/working limits; a valid near-4-GiB RIFF artifact may therefore exceed that decoder's hard resource policy.
